notes: Structurally identical to the Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals but cleaner: 'while gently swinging this censer' is an honest holding_item predicate (the bearer holds and swings the censer to activate), which exists in the surface. The brazier required a proximity gate on a stationary item (surface_widening); the censer does not. Minor omissions not blocking clean status: (1) spawn placement 'as close to the censer as possible' is not modeled — only a coarse Range.self header is emitted; (2) 'understands your languages' is not expressible on a catalog_ref creature; (3) no explicit command range or fallback behavior in RAW — encoded with commandRangeFeet=0 and defaultBehavior=dodge_and_avoid as conservative placeholders matching the Brazier precedent.
